meta.name: Mission Over Mars
meta.description:
Based on true events, Mission Over Mars depicts the inspiring story of four women who played a pivotal role in the Mars Orbiter Mission. And how they fight both professional and personal battles, to triumph for India ki sabse oonchi udaan.

Ended · First aired 10 Sept 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 30 min
Studio: ALTBalaji · Network: ALTBalaji, ZEE5

Not complete. On your server: S1 5/8 (missing E6-8)

videos.title: Chala Toh Chaand Tak, Nahin Toh Shaam Tak
videos.overview: ISA scientist Moushami Ghosh faces her biggest setback when her team loses contact with India’s ChandraViman-1 while China’s mission to the moon succeeds. As India sets its eyes on Mars, China once again beats it with another successful mission even before Moushami and her team can get approval for India’s Mars mission.

videos.title: To Mars
videos.overview: The PMO office agrees to fund M.O.M on the condition that the mission is launched within 18 months. The ISA agrees to this condition. Team M.O.M, headed by Nandita, must now prove the skeptics wrong and make M.O.M a success.

videos.title: 7 Rupees Per Kilometer
videos.overview: Nandita is devasted when the Centre allocates only USD 75 Million for the entire mission. She tries some cost-cutting measures but still finds it difficult to work within the limited budget. Later, MSLV fails its first test launch. Can ISA afford a second test launch?

videos.title: Phuljhadi Wala Rocket
videos.overview: After MSLV fails the test for the second time, Moushami suggests that they use the tried and test ESLV instead. But it only has a success rate of 36 percent. Will Nandita and her team be able to pull off a third test launch?

videos.title: 100% Indian
videos.overview: In the review meeting, Moushumi and her team fail to present their complete plan. Moushumi offers to step down as she may have overestimated her capabilities. Later, Gautam offers to seek the help of the American space agency, but Dr. Murlidharan is adamant about keeping M.O.M a 100 % Indian program.
